summary: Allows multi-architecture release images to finish on hosted runners instead of cancelling both frontend build attempts at a fixed 30-minute limit.
userImpact: Release operators receive signed, scanned, smoke-tested backend and frontend containers when ARM64 emulation needs more than 30 minutes.
EnterpriseGlue 0.19.1 fixes forward from the incomplete 0.19.0 container publication without changing application behavior.

instructions: Use the matching 0.19.1 backend and frontend image tags when deploying containers; source and package consumers do not need to change configuration.

notes: This release-automation correction does not change the database schema or migration sequence.

security: The extended build window does not bypass signing, provenance, multi-architecture, smoke-test, or HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerability gates.
documentation: The versioned release notes identify 0.19.1 as a container-publication recovery with no application compatibility change.
rollback: Revert the workflow timeout change if hosted runner performance returns below the previous limit; already published immutable image tags and digests remain unchanged.
validation: Reproduce the 0.19.0 release failure where both multi-architecture frontend attempts reach the 30-minute action timeout.
Run the Docker workflow contract tests and release-note validation for the extended timeout.
Publish 0.19.1 through the protected hotfix workflow and verify exact digests, architectures, signatures, provenance, smoke tests, and vulnerability scans.
